The title of '''Syndic''' was a designation of rank used in some societies, particularly among the [[Chiss/Legends|Chiss]].

==Overview==
Several distinct pieces of evidence go some way toward defining the title of Syndic as used among the Chiss.

*It is known that a title of Syndic was used by representatives of the [[Mitth family/Legends|Eighth Ruling Family]], including, in [[27 BBY/Legends|27 BBY]], [[Mitth'ras'safis/Legends|Mitth'ras'safis]] (Thrass), brother of the future Imperial [[Grand Admiral/Legends|Grand Admiral]] [[Mitth'raw'nuruodo/Legends|Mitth'raw'nuruodo]] (Thrawn). It is possible that the other [[Ruling Families/Legends|Ruling Families]] also used the title in similar ways, but no direct evidence exists.<ref name="Outbound Flight" />
*Among the warriors of his own rogue [[Syndic Mitth'raw'nuruodo's Household Phalanx|Household Phalanx]], Mitth'raw'nuruodo was later known formally as "Syndic Mitth'raw'nuruodo," suggesting that he had acceded to a comparable position to that which his brother had once held; the [[Phalanx (Chiss)|Household Phalanx]] was not commanded by Mitth'raw'nuruodo himself, however, but by [[Kres'ten'tarthi|Stent]], with the rank of [[Commander/Legends|Commander]]. In [[22 ABY/Legends|22 ABY]], [[Aristocra/Legends|Aristocra]] [[Chaf'orm'bintrano]] also referred to Mitth'raw'nuruodo as "Syndic".<ref name="Survivor's Quest">''[[Survivor's Quest]]''</ref>
*A study produced by the [[University of Sanbra]] in the last years of the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]], says that [[Phalanx (Chiss)|Colonial Phalanxes]], the military forces attached to the twenty eight colony worlds of the [[Chiss Ascendancy/Legends|Chiss Ascendancy]], were usually led by a Syndic appointed by a [[House leader]]. This passage could be read as a different way of describing the same sort of chain of command found in Mitth'raw'nuruodo's Phalanx, but the phrasing of the text suggests that the Syndic of a Colonial Phalanx was its direct military commander, and it is possible that we ought to distinguish two types of Syndic, and two types of Phalanx.
*The existence of a rank of Syndic with high authority over the whole [[Chiss Expansionary Defense Force]] is implied by former Imperial General Baron [[Soontir Fel/Legends|Soontir Fel's]] assumption of the rank of [[Assistant Syndic]] when he joined the CEDF in about [[29 ABY/Legends|29 ABY]].
*However, when Baron Fel identified Commander [[Ina'ganet'nuruodo]] (Ganet) as the Phalanx commander for "a rival Syndic," he was probably indicating that she served another Syndic of the same type as Mitth'ras'safis and Mitth'raw'nuruodo, with Ina'ganet'nuruodo's position being presumably comparable to that of [[Kres'ten'tarthi]] (Stent).

On present knowledge, it is hard to infer the underlying structures behind these varied references with any confidence, although further information will no doubt enable fuller analysis. It can, additionally, be noted that the title of Syndic was not exclusively restricted to the Chiss. For instance, [[Talon Karrde]] sometimes used the alias of Syndic Pandis Hart, chief purchasing agent of the [[Sif-Uwana Council]] on the planet [[Sif-Uwana]].<ref name="FC" />
